niche_backs.concept: Single cut piece of large-format tile per niche back (zero grout joints on back wall)
candidate_formats: 24x48 large-format porcelain/ceramic (~23.6 x 47.2 in actual): 1 single tile cuts BOTH ~11x19 Left and ~7.5x14 Right niche backs + sills with generous margin even if Left Niche > 11-7/8 in

Thin stone/quartz slab remnant (note: 5/16-3/8 in porcelain preserves full shampoo shelf depth better than 3/4 in stone)
candidate_finishes: Glossy solid white large-format tile (matches 0025 Ice White 3x6 field, quietest seamless look)
Soft white/gray veined marble-look porcelain (echoes stone tub surround & floor)
